preconditions.description: The number of horses n is at least 1 and the number of enemy pairs m is non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in enemies)
preconditions.description: Each enemy pair (ai, bi) consists of distinct horses with indices between 1 and n.
The number of enemy pairs in the input matches the given m.

preconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for aj, bj in enemies if ai in (aj, bj)) <= 3 for ai in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each horse has at most 3 enemies.

postconditions.expression: stdout in {'-1', ''.join(str(p) for p in party) for party in product([0, 1], repeat=n) if all(sum(party[ai-1] == party[bi-1] for ai, bi in enemies) <= 1)}
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if no valid split exists, or a string of n characters where each character is '0' or '1' indicating the party of each horse, ensuring no horse has more than one enemy in its party.
